Usage: perch br [<branch>|pr:<n>|mr:<n>]
                                  Check the branch out here
       perch br rm [<branch>] [--upstream] [--force]
                                  Remove local branches
       perch br -- <branch>   Check out a branch named rm

Options:
      --upstream  Also offer the branch's same-named upstream for removal
      --force     Skip destructive confirmations
